import base64,hashlib,json,math,pathlib,zlib
from fractions import Fraction as F
R=pathlib.Path.cwd();S=1<<149
PLO=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937510')
PHI=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937511')
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def digest(v):return sha(json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode())
def q(v):return F(*v)
def value(w,domain=True):
    assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<1<<64
    e=(w>>52)&2047;m=w&((1<<52)-1);assert e!=2047
    if domain:assert e!=0 or m==0
    sign=-1 if w>>63 else 1
    return sign*F(m)*F(2)**(-1074) if e==0 else sign*F((1<<52)+m)*F(2)**(e-1075)
def nearest(w,x):
    candidates=[t for t in (w-1,w,w+1,0,1<<63) if 0<=t<1<<64 and (t>>52)&2047!=2047]
    assert w==min(candidates,key=lambda t:(abs(value(t,False)-x),t&1,t))
    return value(w)


def read_report(p,h):
    b=(R/p).read_bytes();assert sha(b)==h;return json.loads(b)
def payload(r):
    s=r if 'rc' in r else r.get('test_run',r.get('run'));b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(s['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
    assert len(b)==s['stdout_bytes'] and sha(b)==s['stdout_sha256'];return json.loads(b)
def poly(x,odd,degree):
    return sum((F((-1)**j)*x**(2*j+odd)/math.factorial(2*j+odd) for j in range(degree+1)),F(0))
def permute(c,s,k):
    k%=4
    return (c,s) if k==0 else (-s,c) if k==1 else (-c,-s) if k==2 else (s,-c)
def relative(actual,n,e,limit):
    lower=max(F(0),n-e);upper=e/lower if lower>0 else None
    expected={'observed_rational':[n.numerator,n.denominator],'absolute_error_upper_rational':[e.numerator,e.denominator],
              'ideal_reference_lower_rational':[lower.numerator,lower.denominator],
              'relative_error_upper_rational':[upper.numerator,upper.denominator] if upper is not None else None,
              'relative_budget_rational':[limit.numerator,limit.denominator],
              'status':'CERTIFIED_BOUND' if upper is not None else 'NO_POSITIVE_REFERENCE_LOWER_BOUND',
              'relative_budget_satisfied':upper is not None and upper<=limit}
    assert actual==expected
    return expected['relative_budget_satisfied']
def validate(r):
    for n,h in r['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert sha((R/n).read_bytes())==h,n
    assert len(r['code_doc_sha256'])==109
    pr=r['previous_report'];sr=read_report(pr['path'],pr['sha256']);sources=payload(sr)['audit']['cases']
    gr=sr['geometry_report'];geometry=payload(read_report(gr['path'],gr['sha256']))['cases']
    ur=sr['previous_report'];units=payload(read_report(ur['path'],ur['sha256']))['audit']['cases']
    cr=r['cache_report'];cache=payload(read_report(cr['path'],cr['sha256']))['audit']['cases']
    NUMERIC='retained-path-coherent-detector-RN64-CPU-v1';CODE='Blender/benchmarks/capacity_audit/axial_reduction_detector_rn64_cpu_v1.py'
    steps={};detectors={};adds={}
    def put(bank,key,m):
        if key in bank:assert digest(bank[key])==digest(m)
        bank[key]=m
    for c in cache.values():
        if not c['scene_field_reduced']:continue
        sig=c['cache_signature'];assert sig['model']==NUMERIC and sig['reducer_code_sha256']==r['code_doc_sha256'][CODE]
        ts=sig['ordered_terminals'];byid={t['source_id']:t for t in ts};assert len(byid)==len(ts)
        for port,p in c['ports'].items():
            for group,g in p['groups'].items():
                ids=[t['source_id'] for t in ts if t['port']==port and t['coherence_group']==group]
                assert ids==g['source_ids']==[s['source_id'] for s in g['steps']]
                acc=[0,0]
                for s in g['steps']:
                    words=byid[s['source_id']]['terminal_uint64'];trace=s['operations'];assert len(trace)==2
                    put(steps,tuple(acc+words),trace);acc=[n['output_uint64'] for n in trace]
                assert acc==g['output_uint64'];put(detectors,tuple(acc),g['detector'])
            prev=0
            for n in p['add_steps']:
                v=q(n['inputs_rational'][1]);matches={g['detector']['output_uint64'] for g in p['groups'].values() if q(g['detector']['observed_power_rational'])==v}
                assert len(matches)==1;put(adds,(prev,matches.pop()),[n]);prev=n['output_uint64']
    run=r['test_run'];assert run['rc']==0 and 'Ran 8 tests' in run['stderr'] and 'OK' in run['stderr']
    evidence=payload(run);a=evidence['audit'];assert a['model']==r['model'] and set(a['cases'])==set(sources)
    assert a['pins_verified']==dict(sr['code_doc_sha256'],**{pr['path']:pr['sha256']}) and len(a['pins_verified'])==106
    flags=('GPU_executed','ALU_executed','native_reduction_detector_implemented','execution_authenticated','coherence_authenticated','accepted_full_field_pipeline','native_promotion_allowed','geometry_unit_source_or_producer_rerun')
    assert all(a[f] is False for f in flags)
    stats={'cases':13,'sources':14,'upstream_stops':0,'calculated_cases':0,'accepted_reduction_cases':0,
           'audit_RN64_nodes_checked':0,'audit_new_RN64':0,'audit_cache_RN64_NOT_executed':0,
           'control_RN64_nodes_checked':0,'control_new_RN64':0,'control_cache_RN64_NOT_executed':0,
           'original_scene_group_field_oracles':0,'original_scene_port_power_oracles':0,
           'coherent_zero_relative_REJECT':False,'separate_groups_different_observable':False,
           'frozen_pins':106,'code_doc_fingerprints':109}
    def trace(t,spec):
        assert len(t)==len(spec);out=[];deltas=[]
        for n,(label,op,x,y) in zip(t,spec):
            assert n['label']==label and n['op']==op and list(map(q,n['inputs_rational']))==[x,y]
            exact=x+y if op=='add' else x*y;v=nearest(n['output_uint64'],exact)
            assert q(n['rounding_delta_rational'])==v-exact;out.append(v);deltas.append(v-exact)
        return out,deltas,[n['output_uint64'] for n in t]
    def one(name,c,control=False):
        source=sources[name];g=geometry[name];scene=g['scene_snapshot'];b=g['word_ABI'];u=units[name]
        ct=c['contract'];binding=source['original_scene_binding_sha256'];rows=ct['assignments']
        assert c['source_product_case_sha256']==digest(source) and c['original_scene_binding_sha256']==ct['scene_binding_sha256']==binding
        assert c['previous_source_product_accepted']==source['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']
        assert ct['grouping_provenance']=='explicit CPU coherence hypothesis; not measured scene/native/physical coherence'
        lim={k:q(v) for k,v in ct['limits'].items()}
        assert set(lim)=={'field_L1','power','relative_field','relative_power'}
        assert lim['power']==F(1,10**12) and lim['relative_field']==lim['relative_power']==F(1,10**6)
        assert lim['field_L1']==(F(0) if control and name=='positive' else F(1,10**12))
        assert [row['source_id'] for row in rows]==source['source_order']==[p['source_id'] for p in source['paths']]
        for row in rows:
            assert row['port']=='D' and row['source_phase_reference_id']=='original-source-zero:'+binding+':'+row['source_id']
            assert row['common_phase_reference_id']=='declared-common-source-gauge:'+binding+':'+row['coherence_group']
        assert c['coherence_authenticated'] is False and c['accepted_full_field_pipeline'] is False
        if not source['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']:
            assert not c['scene_field_reduced'] and not c['detector_evaluated'] and not c['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only']
            assert c['new_RN64_operations']==c['cached_RN64_operations_NOT_executed']==0 and c['ports']=={}
            stats['upstream_stops']+=len(source['paths']);return
        if not control:stats['calculated_cases']+=1
        assert c['scene_field_reduced'] and c['detector_evaluated']
        groups={}
        for idx,(p,row) in enumerate(zip(source['paths'],rows)):
            assert p['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only'] and p['phase_reference_id']==row['source_phase_reference_id'] and p['port']==row['port']
            groups.setdefault(row['coherence_group'],[]).append((idx,p,row))
        port=c['ports']['D'];assert set(port['groups'])==set(groups)
        signatures=[];new=0;cached=0;valid=True;power=F(0);powerword=0;powerbound=F(0);oraclepower=F(0);oracletail=F(0)
        def sig(kind,key,reused):
            return {'kind':kind,'input_uint64':list(key),'model':NUMERIC,'code_sha256':r['code_doc_sha256'][CODE],'report_sha256':cr['sha256'] if reused else None}
        for group,members in groups.items():
            saved=port['groups'][group];acc=[0,0];pathbound=F(0);redbound=F(0);oracle=[F(0),F(0)];tail=F(0)
            assert saved['source_ids']==[p['source_id'] for idx,p,row in members]==[s['source_id'] for s in saved['steps']]
            assert saved['common_phase_reference_id']==members[0][2]['common_phase_reference_id']
            for step,(idx,p,row) in zip(saved['steps'],members):
                words=p['measurement']['output_uint64'];z=list(map(value,words));key=tuple(acc+words);reuse=key in steps
                assert step['cache_reused']==reuse
                if reuse:assert digest(step['operations'])==digest(steps[key])
                values,deltas,acc=trace(step['operations'],[('reduce.'+str(j),'add',value(acc[j]),z[j]) for j in range(2)])
                new+=0 if reuse else 2;cached+=2 if reuse else 0;signatures.append(sig('reduce2',key,reuse))
                pathbound+=q(p['composed_path_field_error_L1']);redbound+=sum(map(abs,deltas),F(0))
                src=scene['sources'][idx];gp=g['sources'][idx];up=u['paths'][idx]
                assert src['id']==gp['source_id']==up['source_id']==p['source_id']
                def plane(owner):return F(scene['objects'][b['object_ids'][owner]]['vertices_world_BU'][0][0])
                cycles=gp['direction_sign']*(2*plane(gp['mirror_owner'])-F(src['position_BU'][0])-plane(gp['terminal_owner']))/F(scene['lambda_BU'])
                assert cycles==q(up['original_cycles_rational'])
                assert F(scene['objects'][b['object_ids'][gp['mirror_owner']]]['phase_rad'])==0
                res=cycles-up['integer_turn']-F(up['quarter_index'],4);phi=(PLO+PHI)*res
                cc,ss=permute(poly(phi,0,24),poly(phi,1,24),up['quarter_index'])
                ar,ai=map(F,src['field_reim']);ideal=[-ar*cc+ai*ss,-ar*ss-ai*cc]
                oracle=[x+y for x,y in zip(oracle,ideal)]
                tail+=(abs(ar)+abs(ai))*(abs(phi)**50/math.factorial(50)+abs(phi)**51/math.factorial(51)+2*abs(res)*(PHI-PLO))
            y=list(map(value,acc));e=pathbound+redbound;norm=sum(map(abs,y),F(0))
            assert saved['output_uint64']==acc and list(map(q,saved['observed_field_rational']))==y
            assert q(saved['path_error_L1'])==pathbound and q(saved['reduction_error_L1'])==redbound and q(saved['composed_field_error_L1'])==e
            assert sum((abs(x-z) for x,z in zip(y,oracle)),F(0))+tail<=e
            stats['original_scene_group_field_oracles']+=1
            assert saved['field_absolute_pass']==(e<=lim['field_L1'])
            rel=relative(saved['relative_field'],norm,e,lim['relative_field']);valid=valid and e<=lim['field_L1'] and rel
            key=tuple(acc);reuse=key in detectors;det=saved['detector'];assert saved['detector_cache_reused']==reuse
            if reuse:assert digest(det)==digest(detectors[key])
            t=det['operations'];v0,d0,w0=trace(t[:2],[('detector.real_square','mul',y[0],y[0]),('detector.imag_square','mul',y[1],y[1])])
            vv,dd,ww=trace(t[2:],[('detector.combine','add',v0[0],v0[1])])
            qpower=vv[0];dp=sum(map(abs,d0+dd),F(0))
            assert det['RN64_operations']==3 and det['output_uint64']==ww[0] and q(det['observed_power_rational'])==qpower
            assert q(det['detector_error_upper_rational'])==dp and q(det['actual_detector_error_rational'])==abs(qpower-y[0]**2-y[1]**2)
            new+=0 if reuse else 3;cached+=3 if reuse else 0;signatures.append(sig('detector3',key,reuse))
            transport=2*norm*e+e*e;pb=transport+dp
            assert q(saved['transport_power_error'])==transport and q(saved['group_power_error'])==pb
            key=(powerword,ww[0]);reuse=key in adds;step=port['add_steps'][list(groups).index(group)]
            assert step['coherence_group']==group and step['cache_reused']==reuse
            if reuse:assert digest(step['operations'])==digest(adds[key])
            v,d,words=trace(step['operations'],[('port.incoherent_sum','add',power,qpower)])
            power=v[0];powerword=words[0];powerbound+=pb+abs(d[0])
            new+=0 if reuse else 1;cached+=1 if reuse else 0;signatures.append(sig('power_add1',key,reuse))
            oraclepower+=oracle[0]**2+oracle[1]**2;oracletail+=2*sum(map(abs,oracle),F(0))*tail+tail*tail
        # Production collects all reduction signatures before any detector/add.
        expected=[s for s in signatures if s['kind']=='reduce2']+[s for s in signatures if s['kind']!='reduce2']
        assert expected==c['cache_signatures']
        assert new==c['new_RN64_operations'] and cached==c['cached_RN64_operations_NOT_executed']
        assert q(port['observed_power_rational'])==power==value(port['observed_power_uint64']) and q(port['composed_power_error'])==powerbound
        assert abs(power-oraclepower)+oracletail<=powerbound
        stats['original_scene_port_power_oracles']+=1
        assert port['power_absolute_pass']==(powerbound<=lim['power'])
        rel=relative(port['relative_power'],power,powerbound,lim['relative_power'])
        assert c['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only']==(valid and powerbound<=lim['power'] and rel)
        prefix='control' if control else 'audit'
        stats[prefix+'_RN64_nodes_checked']+=new+cached;stats[prefix+'_new_RN64']+=new;stats[prefix+'_cache_RN64_NOT_executed']+=cached
        if not control:stats['accepted_reduction_cases']+=int(c['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only'])
    for name,c in a['cases'].items():one(name,c)
    assert stats['audit_new_RN64']==a['new_RN64_operations'] and stats['audit_cache_RN64_NOT_executed']==a['cached_RN64_operations_NOT_executed']
    one('two_sources',evidence['separate_group_control'],True);one('positive',evidence['zero_cap_control'],True)
    zero=a['cases']['two_sources'];sep=evidence['separate_group_control'];zc=evidence['zero_cap_control']
    assert zero['ports']['D']['groups']['g']['observed_field_rational']==[[0,1],[0,1]] and zero['ports']['D']['observed_power_rational']==[0,1]
    assert not zero['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only'] and zero['ports']['D']['relative_power']['status']=='NO_POSITIVE_REFERENCE_LOWER_BOUND'
    stats['coherent_zero_relative_REJECT']=True
    assert zero['contract']['limits']==sep['contract']['limits'] and sep['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only']
    assert q(sep['ports']['D']['observed_power_rational'])>F(19,1000)
    stats['separate_groups_different_observable']=True
    assert not zc['accepted_reduction_detector_CPU_only'] and zc['ports']['D']['groups']['g']['detector']==a['cases']['positive']['ports']['D']['groups']['g']['detector']
    assert stats['upstream_stops']==8 and stats['calculated_cases']==5 and stats['accepted_reduction_cases']==4
    if r.get('independent_validation',{}).get('result'):assert stats==r['independent_validation']['result']
    return stats
r=json.loads((R/'coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-GEOMETRY-REDUCTION-001-CODEX.json').read_bytes())
print(json.dumps(validate(r),sort_keys=True))
